title: Validator YAML rules
description: Vault-author-facing declarative validator surface. Lives at <vault>/<module>.validators.yaml.

facts.description: Per-bucket constraints. Bucket names match the active FactsSchema's top-level properties.

required.description: Whether the bucket must be present in payload.facts.

min_items.description: Minimum array length (applies when bucket is an array).

min_length.description: Minimum string length (applies when bucket is a string).

require_evidence_ref.description: If true, every notable[].evidence_ref must be non-empty (default behavior).
